what_this_is: The well known songs the 8 September curation dropped, put back into the same packs they were in that day, appended at the end so nothing already there moved.
how_to_read_it: restored = songs put back, with the packs each went into. held_metal = songs that qualified on listeners but carry a metal tag, kept out of the general packs until there is a Metal pack. skipped = qualified but could not go into a pack, with the reason.
rule: 500,000 Last.fm listeners or more, in a pack on 8 September, no metal tag in the top 3 tags and no metal tag weighted 25 or more.
tag_source: Last.fm track.getTopTags, falling back to artist.getTopTags where Last.fm returns no track tags
